invariants.rationale: The first operation of the method is to set sizeInvalid to false.
prefWidth is initialized to 0 and only increased or set via Math.max and potentially Math.ceil, both of which preserve non-negativity.
Similar to prefWidth, prefHeight is initialized to 0 or to padding values and assigned by Math.max and Math.ceil.
Pairs of y,columnWidth are always added to columnSizes; so, if not null, it must have even length at method exit.
If wrap is true, columnSizes is always created if null at the start of the branch.

meta.value: columnSizes always initialized when wrap is true
